author: blu
body: Proves the tap-AI now fires three previously-inert authored activated abilities. Royal Assassin ("{T}: destroy target tapped creature") kills the opponent's biggest TAPPED creature (only tapped ones, so it is faithful and not a free repeatable kill). Disrupting Scepter ("{3},{T}: target player discards a card") makes the opponent discard when the opponent has cards. Nevinyrral's Disk ("{1},{T}: destroy all nonland permanents") is symmetric, so it fires only when the opponent controls more non-land permanents than the caster. Each is exercised through ai-activate-taps on an isolated board.
